renderPacket.identity: Real Li River near Xingping/Yangshuo from an elevated Xianggong Hill viewpoint: winding river threading through layered steep limestone-karst towers, small riverside fields/villages only as scale, broad horizontal 3:2 composition with stronger karst mass centre-right and quieter sky/river text-safe area, soft early-morning atmospheric haze, restrained natural green/slate/muted warm tones, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4; no staged fisherman, oversized raft, fantasy peaks or poster sunrise.

Real Jinshanling Great Wall: long wall and multiple watchtowers following rolling mountain ridges, broad oblique ridge composition with deep spatial layering, restrained early-autumn greens and ochres in soft daylight; no crowds, impossible aerial angle, fantasy mountains or exaggerated wall width.

Real Forbidden City from Jingshan Park looking south: layered red walls, yellow-glazed roofs, gates and courtyards aligned on the imperial central axis with Beijing context beyond, elevated broad composition and soft clear daylight; no fantasy palace enlargement, parade, giant flags or impossible emptiness.

Real Shanghai Huangpu River from the Bund toward Lujiazui: broad river, recognisable Oriental Pearl and major Pudong towers at natural scale, Bund edge only secondary, restrained early-morning or soft blue-hour atmosphere; no cyberpunk neon, invented towers, billboard emphasis or readable generated signage.

Real Wulingyuan/Yuanjiajie quartz-sandstone pillar landscape: many forested pillars and narrow ridges receding through light natural mist, broad landscape composition with deep atmospheric layers; no floating rocks, Avatar fantasy, impossible needle thinness or theatrical storm.

Real Potala Palace in full profile from the classic Chakpori/Yaowang Mountain side viewpoint: white and red palace mass on Marpo Ri with Lhasa valley and distant plateau mountains in context, soft early-morning high-altitude light and real proportions; no staged monks, oversized flags, fantasy snow peaks or devotional poster lighting.

Real Tianluokeng Fujian Tulou cluster from an elevated oblique viewpoint: four circular and one square earthen tulou embedded in green cultivated mountain slopes, earthy walls and dark tiled roofs clearly recognisable; no vertical map-like drone view, tourist crowd, fantasy-perfect circles or decorative staging.

Real Dunhuang Crescent Lake and Mingsha dunes from an elevated dune viewpoint: crescent oasis and pavilion complex at natural scale inside a much larger amber dune landscape, pale sky and restrained oasis vegetation; no camel caravan, giant crowd, fantasy oasis or saturated poster sunset.

Real Honghe Hani rice terraces at Duoyishu/Yuanyang: curving water-filled terraces descending through a misty valley, forest and village high on the slope where plausible, cool early-morning light with restrained warm highlights; no rainbow reflections, excessive saturation, giant people or tourism-poster sunrise.

Peking roast duck as one finished serving on one plain plate: neatly sliced duck with lacquered deep-amber crisp skin and pale meat visible, slices arranged centrally; no pancakes, scallions, cucumber, sauce bowl, chopsticks, carving props or second dish.

Xiaolongbao as one finished serving in one simple bamboo steamer: 5–7 pale steamed soup dumplings with delicate pleated tops and realistic soft dough; no dipping sauce, ginger, chopsticks, tea, garnish scatter or second plate.

Mapo tofu in one shallow bowl: distinct tofu cubes in red-brown chilli-bean sauce with restrained minced meat and only minimal integral green/Sichuan-pepper finish inside the bowl; no rice, spoon, chopsticks, condiment bowls or scattered spices.

Lanzhou beef noodles in one simple bowl: clear broth, hand-pulled noodles, thin beef slices, small integral white radish and green herb/scallion only inside the bowl; no side condiments, chilli bowl, chopsticks, napkin, drink or second dish.
